verdict.rationale: Sumsub's REST API covers core verification workflows (applicant creation, document/liveness checks, approve/reject, AML screening, webhooks) [sumsub-docs-1,15,22,37,16] and even offers an MCP server letting AI agents perform Sumsub operations under role permissions [sumsub-docs-4]. However, several dashboard-only capabilities (team member management, SSO/SAML setup, branding/SDK customization, client lists) are described purely as Dashboard actions with no API equivalent mentioned, and no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found by probes. missing for 10: confirmed API endpoints for team/SSO management, branding/customization config, and a published OpenAPI spec proving full UI-API parity.
